Subject: Next steps + 30m product intro — proposed windows

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about how Orchid Metrics pipelines telemetry and how you’re thinking about embedding model outputs into your analytics layer. Quick recap and suggested next step:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary use: automated anomaly detection + natural-language explanations surfaced in the analyst UI.
- Key constraints: sub-second inference for UI, strict data residency for PII-derived features, and pilot target of 3 teams by Q1.

Next step: 30-minute product intro demo (high-level plus quick look at latency/cost tradeoffs). Can you pick one of the windows below? I’m proposing a couple of times that cover both east/west coast availability. If none work, send two windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Options (all times PT):
1) Wed 11/04 — 09:00–09:30 PT (12:00–12:30 ET)
2) Wed 11/04 — 13:30–14:00 PT (16:30–17:00 ET)
3) Thu 11/05 — 08:00–08:30 PT (11:00–11:30 ET) — earlier slot if you prefer mornings

Who to invite: product + 1 technical stakeholder (we assume ~3 people max for an intro).

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan and a proposed agenda to help set expectations.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-Orchid-v0.3.pdf (stub), 30min-demo-agenda.md (stub)

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Marissa (solutions engineer) if you want any technical depth.

Best,
Karthik
